local_notes: Founded 10 Jan 2010 (HIMPSI). SIPP 20100605-2023-03-1784, valid to 02 Aug 2028; SIAP 20100605, listed validity 09 Mar 2024 (may be lapsed or renewed, unverified). Shares the address with 'Fusfa Homestay' (homestay syariah, 14 rooms, opened 2019), so look for the clinic sign at the homestay. Near Lapangan Murjani and the Panglima Batur area. Jehan Safitri was head of Bidang Sertifikasi & Ijin Praktik at HIMPSI Kalsel (2018–2022), her M.Psi Profesi is from Unair (2010), and she teaches clinical psychology, counselling and psychotherapy. She is NOT on the IPK Banjarbaru clinical registry page (HIMPSI is a separate body).
